messages:
incident-bot: PROD alert — streaming decode p99 > 2.5s in us-west for 4m, error rate still low but tail latency spike. auto-escalation -> paging oncall.

pagerduty: PAGER: @alice-ng (primary oncall) triggered for PROD - streaming tail latency

alice-ng: I'm on it. looking at dashboards now. p95 ~ 400ms, p99 jumped to 2.6s on streaming/kv-decode route. :thinking_face:

benji: i see concurrent increase in kernel compilepath time on the TRT nodes around same time. logs show a bunch of link-time stalls when decode path loads flash-attn kernels.

carol-sre: can you paste the kernel/build id? might be the new trt8 kernel variant we rolled yesterday

benji: build id `trt8-fla-v2+2026-03-14-21` — rollout at 21:12 UTC yesterday. stack traces show repeated `compilepath::link()` backoffs and page faults.

dmitri-rt: we're seeing heavy vmalloc/alloc_retry in dmesg on a subset of pods. KV cache misses go up and the runtime stalls while mapping pages for the new kernels. suspect compilepath regressed memory footprint or locking.

alice-ng: tagging @eva-support to start customer impact. Eva - any top customers complaining about slow streaming responses in last 10m?

eva-support: pulled CS queue — two customers reported degraded streaming behavior (cust-omega and cust-lumen). both low-severity experimental workloads but show retries. No escalations yet. I'll flag AM contacts.

carol-sre: short mitigation options: 1) pin traffic off TRT8 nodes -> route to trt7 pool 2) rollback kernel on a small set (hotpatch) 3) enable compilepath fallback flag we have (runtime.env COMPILEPATH_FALLBACK=1)

dmitri-rt: quick test — adding runtime flag on one pool to force precompiled kernels. this should avoid link-time stalls but will increase memory use slightly.

alice-ng: do option 1 first (reroute), then enable fallback on a few hosts, then consider rollback if that doesn't help. I'll coordinate.

alice-ng: runbook snippet I'm executing:

```
# reroute traffic away from trt8 pool
redwoodctl routes update --service streaming --exclude-pool trt8-usw-01
# enable compilepath fallback on control plane for test pool
redwoodctl pools set-env trt8-usw-test COMPILEPATH_FALLBACK=1
```

benji: reroute command submitted, propagation expected ~30s.

incident-bot: Route update accepted. Propagating config to edge routers.

alice-ng: fallback flag set on trt8-usw-test. watching p99

carol-sre: logs from trt8-usw-01 show repeated faults, here's an excerpt:

```
[2026-03-15T21:12:03Z] compilepath: linking kernel flash_attn_smem.cu -> stall 120ms
[2026-03-15T21:12:03Z] vmalloc: retry alloc failed, trying remap
[2026-03-15T21:12:04Z] runtime: kv-cache miss -> block on page-in
```

dmitri-rt: after reroute p99 dropped to ~520ms within 45s. great. fallback pool still shows a few spikes but much lower.

alice-ng: confirming customer reports — Eva, can you message cust-omega that we mitigated and we'll follow up with root cause? keep tone: we're investigating kernel variant, offering to roll back test if they want.

eva-support: copied. sending note now. template used: "We're aware of transient streaming latency in us-west, mitigation applied. No data loss. Follow-up with RCA." :white_check_mark:

benji: propose we pin TRT8 rollout to 0% and start a controlled rollback of the kernel package on the affected hosts. rollback plan: hotpatch to `trt7-compatible` kernel variant on trt8-usw-01 and trt8-usw-02, monitor for 10m, then recommence rollout if stable.

carol-sre: agree. also we should snapshot affected host state and attach dmesg + perf traces to the incident ticket: INC-17321.

alice-ng: i'll kick off the rollback. executing hotpatch now on two hosts.

```
# hotpatch rollback
ssh root@trt8-usw-01 'service kernel-hotpatch apply trt7-compat.tar.gz && systemctl restart redwood-runtime'
ssh root@trt8-usw-02 'service kernel-hotpatch apply trt7-compat.tar.gz && systemctl restart redwood-runtime'
```

incident-bot: Hotpatch jobs queued (job-7894). ETA 2m.

dmitri-rt: once restarted, check for pagefault reductions in `dmesg -T` and monitor `runtime.metrics.kv_cache_miss` and `decode.latency.p99`

benji: trt8-usw-01 finished hotpatch, runtime back up. initial checks: no immediate vmalloc retry messages.

alice-ng: p99 across cluster now ~280ms, trt8-usw-02 still mid-hotpatch. good sign.

carol-sre: capturing perf traces now. will attach to INC-17321 with notes.

eva-support: customers updated: both acknowledged mitigation, asked for ETA on full fix.

alice-ng: ETA: full rollback and verification in next 20m, RCA to follow. we'll keep customers informed.

benji: preliminary root cause hypothesis: trt8 flash-attn kernels introduced additional per-kernel memory map operations that cause worst-case link-time page allocations under memory pressure on older driver. compilepath didn't handle the new allocation pattern, leading to backoffs and stalls.

dmitri-rt: followups: recreate with stress test, run with mem-pressure tooling, instrument compilepath to log link-time alloc sizes.

carol-sre: ops checklist for handoff to next oncall (in 2h):
- ensure trt8 rollout pinned to 0% in control plane
- confirm all affected hosts show stable p99 < 350ms for 30m
- attach perf + dmesg to INC-17321
- escalate to kernel team if further anomalies found
- notify infra to schedule a patched compilepath that avoids remap pattern

alice-ng: handing off to @carol-sre for overnight watch. I'll be reachable if needed. Handoff notes: mitigation applied (reroute + hotpatch rollback), customers notified, INC-17321 created.

carol-sre: taking handoff. will watch dashboards and continue RCA tomorrow with @dmitri-rt and @benji. thanks all.

pagerduty: INCIDENT ACKNOWLEDGED by carol-sre. Incident remains open.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status -> mitigated, severity -> Sev2 (customer impact limited), link -> INC-17321

alice-ng: closing comms from my side. good job team. :clap:
